01

“the Self-Subsisting [al-Qayyum]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
the Self-Subsisting [al-Qayyum] [al-Baqara 255] means: "the One who stands over everything."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
الْقَيُّومُ [البقرة: 255] يَعْنِي: «الْقَائِمَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ»
Edition record 371883 · p. 248Link to report ↗
02

“confirming what was before it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words, Mighty and Majestic:
confirming what was before it [al-Baqara 97], meaning: "what came before it of Scripture or messenger."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ [البقرة: 97] ، يَعْنِي: «لِمَا قَبْلَهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ أَوْ رَسُولٍ»
Edition record 371884 · p. 248Link to report ↗
03

“precise verses”

Five explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:7).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
precise verses [Al Imran 7]: He says: "what is firmly established in them of the lawful and unlawful and the like."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ [آل عمران: 7] يَقُولُ: «أُحْكِمَ مَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْحَلَالِ وَالْحَرَامِ وَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ»
Edition record 371885 · p. 248Link to report ↗
04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and others unspecific [mutashabihat] [Al Imran 7]: He says: "parts of it confirm one another, as in His words and He misleads by it only the defiantly disobedient [al-Baqara 26], and as in His words thus God places defilement upon those who do not believe [al-Anam 125], and as in His words He increased them in guidance and gave them their righteousness [Muhammad 17]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ [آل عمران: 7] يَقُولُ: " يُصَدِّقُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا، كَقَوْلِهِ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلَّا الْفَاسِقِينَ [البقرة: 26] ، وَكَقَوْلِهِ كَذَلِكَ يَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ [الأنعام: 125] ، وَكَقَوْلِهِ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَآتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ [محمد: 17] "
Edition record 371886 · p. 248Link to report ↗

زَيْغٌ [آل عمران: 7] قَالَ: «شَكٌّ»

seeking discord [Al Imran 7], meaning: "the destructions by which they were destroyed."

“and wretched is the resting place”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:12).

08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and wretched is the resting place [Al Imran 12] he said: "wretched is what they prepared for themselves."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،

05

“There has already been for you a sign in the two armies that met”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:13).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
There has already been for you a sign in the two armies that met [Al Imran 13]: "in Muhammad ﷺ and his companions, and the polytheists of Quraysh, on the day of Badr."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ آيَةٌ فِي فِئَتَيْنِ الْتَقَتَا فِئَةٌ [آل عمران: 13] «فِي مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابِهِ، وَمُشْرِكِي قُرَيْشٍ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ»
Edition record 371891 · p. 249Link to report ↗

07

“Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of God and kill the…”

An explanation transmitted from Maqil ibn Abi Miskin (Q 3:21).

12
Explanation from Maqil ibn Abi Miskin 12

Maqil ibn Abi Miskin

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Maqil ibn Abi Miskin, on His words:
Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of God and kill the prophets without right and kill those among the people who order justice [Al Imran 21], he said: "A prophet of the Children of Israel would receive revelation without receiving a book; he would stand and admonish his people and be killed; then men who had followed him and believed him would stand and admonish them and be killed. They are the ones who order justice among the people."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ أَبِي مِسْكِينٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ النَّبِيِّينَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ الَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِ [آل عمران: 21] قَالَ: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ يَأْتِيهِ الْوَحْيُ وَلَا يَأْتِيهِ كِتَابٌ، فَيَقُومُ فَيُذَكِّرُ قَوْمَهُ فَيُقْتَلُ، فَيَقُومُ رِجَالٌ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَهُ وَصَدَّقَهُ، فَيُذَكِّرُونَهُمْ، فَيُقْتَلُونَ، فَهُمُ الَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِالْقِسْطِ مِنَ النَّاسِ»
Edition record 371894 · p. 250Link to report ↗
08

“You cause the night to enter into the day and cause the day to enter…”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:27).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
You cause the night to enter into the day and cause the day to enter into the night [Al Imran 27] he said: "what decreases from one of them enters into the other."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ [آل عمران: 27] قَالَ: «مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا دَخَلَ فِي الْآخَرِ»
Edition record 371895 · p. 250Link to report ↗
14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and You bring the living out of the dead [Al Imran 27], meaning: You bring out the sperm, the egg, ⦗p. 251⦘ the grain, and the like; You bring out the living from it and the dead from the living. He said: "You bring out the sperm, the egg, and the grain, bringing them out of the living."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَتُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ [آل عمران: 27] ، يَعْنِي: تُخْرِجُ النُّطْفَةَ وَالْبَيْضَةَ ⦗ص: 251⦘ وَالْحَبَّةَ، وَأَشْبَاهَ هَذَا ، تُخْرِجُ مِنْهُ الْحَيَّ وَتُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ، قَالَ: «تُخْرِجُ النُّطْفَةَ وَالْبَيْضَةَ وَالْحَبَّةَ ، تُخْرِجُهَا مِنَ الْحَيِّ»
Edition record 371896 · p. 250Link to report ↗
09

“Let not the believers take disbelievers as allies instead of the…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:28).

15
Explanation from Mujāhid 15

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Let not the believers take disbelievers as allies instead of the believers [Al Imran 28], he said: "meaning: except by way of courtesy in the world."
العربية
الإسناد

لَا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِنْ دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ [آل عمران: 28] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي: إِلَّا مُصَانَعَةً فِي الدُّنْيَا "
Edition record 371897 · p. 251Link to report ↗
10

“and Zechariah took charge of her”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 3:37).

16
Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and Zechariah took charge of her [Al Imran 37]: He says: "he cast lots with them with his pen and won the lot"; then every time Zechariah entered upon her in the sanctuary, he found with her provision [Al Imran 37]: he said: "meaning fruit out of season."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا [آل عمران: 37] يَقُولُ: «سَاهَمَهُمْ بِقَلَمِهِ فَسَهَمَهُمْ» فَكَانَ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا الْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا رِزْقًا [آل عمران: 37] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي ثَمَرًا فِي غَيْرِ زَمَانِهِ»
Edition record 371898 · p. 251Link to report ↗
17
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 17

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
he found with her provision [Al Imran 37]: He said: "He found with her grapes in a basket, out of season. There he called upon his Lord, that is, at that point he called upon his Lord, and said: 'He who provided Mary with this out of season is able to provide me a child from my barren wife.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ

28
Explanation from Mujāhid 28

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
"Believe in what was revealed to those who believed at the beginning of the day, and disbelieve at its end [Al Imran 72]" he said: "They are the Jews, who prayed the dawn prayer with the Messenger of God ﷺ at the beginning of the day and disbelieved at the end of the day, as a ruse, to show people that error had become clear to them in him after they had followed him."
العربية
الإسناد

آمِنُوا بِالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَجْهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكْفُرُوا آخِرَهُ [آل عمران: 72] قَالَ: «هُمُ الْيَهُودُ، صَلَّوْا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ وَكَفَرُوا آخِرَ النَّهَارِ، مَكْرًا مِنْهُمْ، لِيُرُوا النَّاسَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَدَتْ لَهُمْ مِنْهُ الضَّلَالَةُ بَعْدَ أَنْ كَانُوا اتَّبَعُوهُ»

29
Explanation from Mujāhid 29

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
"that anyone would be given the like of what you were given [Al Imran 73]," out of envy from the Jews that prophethood should be in others than them; they wanted them to follow their religion. So God said: "Say, O Muhammad, Indeed, the bounty is in the hand of God [Al Imran 73]; He selects for His mercy whom He wills [al-Baqara 105]," meaning prophethood.

الإسناد

" يُؤْتَى أَحَدٌ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيتُمْ [آل عمران: 73] حَسَدًا مِنَ الْيَهُودِ أَنْ تَكُونَ النُّبُوَّةُ فِي غَيْرِهِمْ، وَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يُتَابِعُوهُمْ عَلَى دِينِهِمْ، فَقَالَ اللَّهُ: قُلْ يَا مُحَمَّدُ: إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ [آل عمران: 73] ، يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ [البقرة: 105] ، يَعْنِي: بِالنُّبُوَّةِ "

34

“Is it not enough for you that your Lord should reinforce you with…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:124, 3:125, 3:126).

46
Explanation from Mujāhid 46

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Is it not enough for you that your Lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels ⦗p. 259⦘ sent down? [Al Imran 124] "He said: It was revealed on the day of Badr." Yes, if you are patient and fear God and they come upon you in this rush of theirs [Al Imran 125], meaning: "in this anger of theirs." He said: "They did not fight them at that hour, and that was the day of Uhud." And on His words, Mighty and Majestic: with five thousand angels, marked [Al Imran 125], meaning: "distinguished, with the tails and forelocks of their horses cut, with wool in them, which is dyed wool; that is the marking." And God made it only as good tidings for you [Al Imran 126]: He says: "God made it so that you would rejoice and be reassured about them." He said: "The angels did not fight with them that day." He said: "And sometimes Ibn Abi Najih said, from Mujahid: The angels did not fight with them that day, nor before it, nor after it, except on the day of Badr."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَلَنْ يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَنْ يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ بِثَلَاثَةِ آلَافٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ ⦗ص: 259⦘ مُنْزَلِينَ [آل عمران: 124] " قَالَ: نَزَلَتْ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ " بَلَى إِنْ تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا وَيَأْتُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْرِهِمْ هَذَا [آل عمران: 125] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنْ غَضَبِهِمْ هَذَا» ، قَالَ: «فَلَمْ يُقَاتِلُوهُمْ تِلْكَ السَّاعَةَ، وَذَلِكَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ» ، وَفِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: بِخَمْسَةِ آلَافٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ [آل عمران: 125] ، يَعْنِي: «مُعَلَّمِينَ، مَجْزُوزَةٍ أَذْنَابُ خُيُولِهِمْ وَنَوَاصِيهَا فِيهَا الصُّوفُ وَهُوَ الْعِهْنُ، وَذَلِكَ التَّسْوِيمُ» وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَى لَكُمْ [آل عمران: 126] يَقُولُ: «جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ لِتَسْتَبْشِرُوا وَلِتَطْمَئِنُّوا إِلَيْهِمْ» ، قَالَ: «فَلَمْ تُقَاتِلْ مَعَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ» ، قَالَ: " وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: لَمْ تُقَاتِلْ مَعَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ إِلَّا يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ "

“You used to wish for death”

53
Explanation from Mujāhid 53

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
You used to wish for death [Al Imran 143] he said: "Some men were absent from Badr, so they wished for a Badr like it so as to obtain the reward and merit that the people of Badr had obtained. العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:

41

“Muhammad is not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on…”

An explanation (Q 3:144).

54
Report 54

Report 54

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from his father: A man of the Emigrants passed by a man of the Ansar who was wallowing in ⦗p. 261⦘ his blood and said to him:
"O so-and-so, did you know that Muhammad has been killed?" The Ansari said: "If Muhammad has been killed, he has conveyed [the message], so fight for your religion." He says: Then there was revealed Muhammad is not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on before him [Al Imran 144] up to His words and whoever turns back on his heels [Al Imran 144]: He says: "whoever apostatizes."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ مَرَّ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ وَهُوَ يَتَشَحَّطُ فِي ⦗ص: 261⦘ دَمِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: يَا فُلَانُ أَشَعَرْتَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا قَدْ قُتِلَ؟ فَقَالَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ: إِنْ كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ قَدْ قُتِلَ فَقَدْ بَلَّغَ ، فَقَاتِلُوا عَنْ دِينِكُمْ، يَقُولُ: فَنَزَلَتْ
وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ [آل عمران: 144] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ [آل عمران: 144] يَقُولُ: «مَنْ يَرْتَدَّ»

Explanation from Mujāhid 62

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and wretched is what they purchase [Al Imran 187] he said: "meaning the Jews' and Christians' alteration of the description and attributes of Muhammad ﷺ and his prophethood in their books. He says: they bought with it what they gained from their lowly people, so wretched is what they purchase."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ [آل عمران: 187] قَالَ: " يَعْنِي تَبْدِيلَ الْيَهُوَدِ وَالنَّصَارَى صِفَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَنَعْتَهُ فِي كُتُبِهِمْ وَنُبُوَّتِهِ، يَقُولُ: اشْتَرَوْا بِهِ مَا كَانُوا يُصِيبُونَ مِنْ سَفِلَتِهِمْ فَبِئْسَ مَا يَشْتَرُونَ "

49

“Do not think that those who rejoice”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 3:188).

63
Explanation from Mujāhid 63

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Do not think that those who rejoice [Al Imran 188], "they are the Jews, who rejoiced at the people's admiration of them and their altering of the Book"; and love to be praised [Al Imran 188]: He says: "they love that people praise them for it"; for what they have not done [Al Imran 188]: they say: "We desire that, but we will not do it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْرَحُونَ [آل عمران: 188] «وَهُمُ الْيَهُوَدُ فَرِحُوا بِإِعْجَابِ النَّاسِ وَتَبْدِيلِهِمُ الْكِتَابَ» ، وَيُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يُحْمَدُوا [آل عمران: 188] ، يَقُولُ: «يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَحْمَدَهُمُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ» ، بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا [آل عمران: 188] ، يَقُولُونَ: «نَهْوَى ذَلِكَ ، وَلَنْ نَفْعَلَهُ»

50

“O you who believe, be patient”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan (Q 3:200).

64
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 64

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, on His words:
O you who believe, be patient [Al Imran 200], and he says: "Be patient in your religion, outdo the disbelievers in patience until they tire of their religion, and be stationed against the polytheists."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: فِي قَوْلِهِ
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا [آل عمران: 200] فَيَقُولُ: «اصْبِرُوا عَلَى دِينِكُمْ وَصَابِرُوا الْكُفَّارَ حَتَّى يَمَلُّوا دِينَهُمْ وَرَابِطُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ»
